headline: You can now drop items onto bag titles in BetterBags Next to assign them to categories or create new ones.

entries.title: Drop items on bag titles to categorize them
entries.details: In BetterBags Next, dropping an item onto the bag or bank header opens a searchable category picker. You can assign the item to an existing category, type a name to create a new category on the spot, or revert a manual assignment back to its default section.
